title: Adrenal Function in GHD Children
brief_summary: To evaluate in children affected by idiopathic GHD the adrenal function both at baseline and after 6 and 12 months of GH treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* prepubertal children with overt idiopathic growth hormone deficiency

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children with organic growth hormone deficiency or under treatment with glucocorticoids
study_population: 30 consecutive children with short stature and overt idiopathic GHD and 30 children with constitutional short stature without endocrine disease
